name: v0.2.1
body:
## What's Changed

* reject out-of-range device numbers in layer https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/36
* createImpliedDirectories: fix directory detection and path handling https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/44
* createImpliedDirectories: honor NoLchown for implied directories https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/70
* createTarFile: use switch for timestamp updates https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/67
* drop redundant ExcludePatterns initialization https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/62
* ExportChanges: use POSIX / Unix conventions for Tar operations https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/41
* getInodeFromStat: return error on failure https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/50
* overlayWhiteoutConverter.ConvertRead: avoid redundant chown https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/55
* overlayWhiteoutConverter.ConvertWrite: explicitly use POSIX / Unix https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/38
* overlayWhiteoutConverter.ConvertWrite: simplify directory check https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/34
* overlayWhiteoutConverter: fixes and cleanups https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/52
* RebaseArchiveEntries: use POSIX / Unix paths https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/42
* tarAppender.addTarFile: normalize archivePath to POSIX https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/40
* tarAppender.addTarFile: return error before writing header https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/51
* TarOptions: document IncludeFiles, ExcludePatterns https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/61
* Unpack: prevent nil-pointer if nil-options are passed https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/66
* remove some intermediate vars https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/53
* rename some vars to prevent shadowing "path" import https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/35
* rename vars to prevent shadowing and for clarity https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/39
* fix typos in comments https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/59
* modernize code https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/30

### Test and CI changes

* ci: don't fail fast https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/74
* ci: update golangci-lint to v2.12 for compatibility with go1.26 https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/46
* ci: pin actions by sha https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/22
* ci: use go.mod for "minimum" Go version, and use custom name https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/29
* golangci-lint: enable gosec linter https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/47
* fix some linting issues and use t.TempDir() in more places https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/31
* add test to verify symlinks targets are preserved (skipped) https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/48
* archive: add regression tests for tar path-traversal containment https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/68
* archive: Add test for implied directories through symlinks https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/76
* archive: fix breakout error type assertions in tests https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/69
* archive: Test extracted file modes with process umask https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/65
* chrootarchive: fix "non-root" skips on Windows https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/71
* Reduce shelling out in tests https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/64
* test: use current user for archive ownership in breakout tests https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/72
* make toUnixPath more generic, and long-path aware https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/58
* testBreakout: pre-create implied victim directory in breakout test https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/73
* TestImpliedDirectoryPermissions: test with umask https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/57

### Dependency updates

* build: bump minimum Go version to 1.24 https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/27
* build: bump minimum Go version to 1.25 https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/28
* update github.com/moby/sys/sequential v0.7.0 https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/75
* update github.com/klauspost/compress v1.18.7 https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/78
* update moby/patternmatcher v0.6.1, klauspost/compress v1.18.3, sirupsen/logrus v1.9.4 https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/23
* update moby/sys dependencies https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/77

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/moby/go-archive/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
